description: Create a short link in the website's organization. confirmed=false (default) returns a preview without writing; confirmed=true creates it.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

deepLinkApp.description: Native app that opens the link on mobile; targetUrl must belong to it.

expiredRedirectUrl.description: Where visitors go after the link expires.

expiresAt.description: When redirects expire; a date alone expires at the start of that UTC day.

externalId.description: Your own ID for the link, such as a CRM record.

folderId.description: ID of an existing folder from the link folder list. Use null to leave the link unfiled or clear the folder.

folderSlug.description: Existing link folder slug. Use this or folderId, never a display name.

slug.description: Path segment of the public short URL; choose a recognizable alias.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: create_link

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. link contains its name, slug, destination, expiry, folder and social-preview settings; saved results also include ID and timestamps; success confirms an applied mutation.

title: Create link
